title: Axiomatic chart grid and token system for compact cost forecasts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: The current compact forecast cards used across Cost Explorer and Spend Insights are inconsistent: different chart gutters, legend treatments, and token usage lead to layout shifts and mismatched density on small viewports. Goal: Create an axiomatic grid and token system that standardizes micro-forecast cards (compact width 288–360px) so they are visually consistent, accessible (AA), and easy for engineers to implement from Figma tokens and component props. Scope: define spacing/typography tokens for compact cards, prescribe chart micro-grid (x-axis tick density, sparkline baseline), legend placement rules, overflow and tooltip strategy, and a migration guide for existing card instances. Out of scope: large dashboard canvases and mobile native SDKs (follow-up work).
comments: 2026-02-11 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff completed with PM and Eng. Collected 18 example cards from console (cost explorer, forecast, budget). Noted three unique legend placements and two different sparkline baselines.
2026-02-18 - Noah Patel: Iteration 1 delivered (Figma frames + token map). Focused on compact typography scale and three spacing tiers for micro-cards. Attached initial prototype link.

2026-02-24 - Sofia Patel (PM): Reviewed prototypes — asked for better contrast on delta indicators and suggested an always-visible truncated legend for multi-series cards. Action: explore micro-legend layout that doesn't increase height.

2026-03-02 - Marco Ruiz (Engineering): Raised implementation constraint — current chart library doesn't support fractional baseline offsets without kernel changes. Proposed fallback where baseline is simulated with overlay. Flagged as engineering dependency.

2026-03-08 - Accessibility review (Anya Chen): Contrast tests noted that the thin sparkline weight falls below AA at 288px on low-DPI. Recommendation: increase stroke or apply a 1px shadow for legibility.
2026-03-12 - Ava Martinez: Updated proposal based on feedback and prepared migration checklist. Pushing to In Review for design leadership sign-off.
decisions: Adopt a 3-tier spacing token set specifically for compact cards: compact-tight (4px), compact (8px), compact-relaxed (12px).
Standardize micro-legend to be a single-row truncated pill under the chart using overflow tooltip for full series names.
Use a 1.5px sparkline weight with optional 1px shadow on low-contrast backgrounds to meet AA contrast.

Chart baseline will be simulated in CSS overlay if the charting library cannot deliver fractional pixel baselines immediately; engineering will create a follow-up request to the chart library for baseline support.
design_files: Token map - compact-spacing-and-typography.json (exported from Figma tokens)
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Patel): Prefer truncated legend over floating legend to avoid card height regressions. OK with token-driven margin changes.
Eng (Marco Ruiz): Needs a clear migration plan and a feature flag for rollout to Dedicated customers to toggle new tokens if regressions appear. Will create ENG follow-up.
Accessibility (Anya Chen): ARIA live region recommended for dynamic deltas when cards are updated in real-time. Include in acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Figma components and token file exported and merged to design-tokens repo.
Prototype demonstrates compact card at 288px and 360px with keyboard focus and tooltip interactions.
Contrast and AA checks pass for all primary states; accessibility reviewer signs off in comments.
Migration checklist includes: list of existing card instances, required token changes, CSS fallbacks, and a staged rollout plan with feature flag.
Engineering has an implementation estimate and dependency ticket for chart-library baseline work.
